title: Avuhz Slice 1 Typed Reference Primitives v1
description: Bounded provider-neutral references to canonical Avuhz records and externally owned objects. References contain identity and version binding only, never embedded domain data, credentials, secret paths, or arbitrary metadata.

internalReferenceType.title: Internal Reference Type
internalReferenceType.description: Closed Slice 1 vocabulary for canonical Avuhz-owned record references. Tenant identity remains a direct tenant_id rather than a typed reference.

internalReference.title: Internal Reference
internalReference.description: Reference to a canonical Avuhz-owned record when exact version binding is not required by the parent contract.

versionedInternalReference.title: Versioned Internal Reference
versionedInternalReference.description: Reference binding an exact canonical Avuhz-owned record version for approval, authority, concurrency, or audit semantics.

reference_version.title: Internal Record Version
reference_version.description: Exact positive integer version of an authoritative internal record.

externalReferenceObjectType.title: External Reference Object Type
externalReferenceObjectType.description: Closed Slice 1 vocabulary for externally owned acquisition objects.

externalVersion.title: External Version
externalVersion.description: Bounded opaque version identifier supplied by an external system. It does not weaken internal positive-integer record versioning.

externalReference.title: External Reference
externalReference.description: Provider-neutral reference to an object owned outside Avuhz, bound to its source and environment. It is never a canonical Avuhz internal identity.
